questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Two point charges +q and +4q are separated by a distance r. A third charge Q is placed so that the system is in equilibrium. The position and value of Q is:
questions.explanation: For equilibrium of all charges, Q must be negative and placed between them. Distance from +q is r/3. Using force balance, Q = -4q/9.
